<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex087042026-02-2316-14-51" status="unreviewed">de'i phyir de la rigs pa'i sgor bzhir che yang 'dir <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3770">kun las btus</rs> bzhin du phye na gsum ste |dngos po stobs zhugs rjes dpag gi bsal ba'i mtshan nyid/dam bcas pa'i gzhi la dam bca' dang tshad mas gnod pa'i <lb edRef="inst:5293" n="51a2"/> 'gal ba tshul gsum pa'i rtags la brten nas bsgrub bya dag pa ba rtogs pa'i blos grub ste |dag pa ni sgras khyad par du ma byas pa zhes zer ba <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4018">chu</rs></note> sgra mi rtag rtogs kyi rjes dpag la ma khyab pa yin no ||
            <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:4006">kha cig</rs> <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference">ral</rs></note> dam bcas pa gang zhig rjes dpag gis gnod pa zhes smra ba ni bsal bya la'ang khyab ches pa yin no ||</seg></TEI>
